record_title: Optimal affine integer grid radius for Mizhaev's genus-three equivelar octahedron
limitations: The sharp radius 84 is only for integer realizations affinely equivalent to Mizhaev's published coordinate realization, not for all realizations of the abstract {9,3} surface. The sharp radius 90 additionally restricts to affine copies in which the conjugated published C4 generator is a Euclidean isometry. The full text of the 2020 precursor was not inspected, and the recent source leaves residual originality risk from parallel work.
